description: Reads a public web page and lists the images that have no alt attribute (missing) or an empty one (empty, which is correct for purely decorative images). Local and private network addresses are refused. This is free by default. Set generate to true to also write suggested alt text for the images found: the image addresses are sent to the AltTextGeneratorAI service, which downloads them, and it uses 1 credit per image.

generate.description: Also write suggested alt text for the images found. Uses 1 credit per image. Default false.

language.description: Language of the alt text, in English, for example spanish, french, german or japanese. Defaults to english. 130+ languages are supported.

max_images.description: With generate, the most images to write alt text for. Default 5, maximum 25.

url.description: Address of the web page (http or https).

name: audit_page
title: Find images without alt text on a web page
